MCT0.33 is named as the highest 28-day compression of this study's mortars, but no number is given for it and the reviewed text does not say it is the CT mortar, so it is not entered as a mix and its finding is not entered.
Binder, sand and activator amounts for the CT, W and CA mortars are not given in the reviewed text.
Specimen geometry, loading protocol and curing duration are not given; the cure record holds only the room-temperature regime.
